description: This file defines the PgSQL class for PostgreSQL database interactions within the Opencart system, including connection handling, querying, escaping, and transaction management.

classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: A class providing PostgreSQL database connection and query execution functionalities for Opencart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided options, sets encoding and timezone.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result as an object with rows and row count.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe SQL usage.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted sequence value.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
